We used the following criteria to filter (remove) terms from GO: 1. Terms with the evidence code ‘inferred by genetic interaction’ (IGI), to avoid potential circularity in predicting genetic interactions in the genotype–phenotype samples. 2. Terms containing fewer than six yeast genes disrupted in the available genotypes (with ‘containment’ defined as all genes annotated to that term or its descendants). 3. Terms that are redundant with respect to their children terms in the ontology.
When a term was removed, all children were connected directly to all parent terms to maintain the hierarchical structure.
The remaining 2,526 terms were used to define the hierarchy of DCell subsystems.
